name: coptic-pronounce
description: Coptic Unicode ↔ English/Arabic phonetic transliteration (pronounce + reverse guess)

scripts.harness:en: npm run build && node scripts/golden-harness.mjs --lang en
scripts.harness:ar: npm run build && node scripts/golden-harness.mjs --lang ar
scripts.harness:verbose: npm run build && node scripts/golden-harness.mjs --lang en --verbose
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-words.mjs && node scripts/smoke-guess.mjs
scripts.test: npm run smoke && node scripts/golden-harness.mjs --lang en --min-score 0.90 && node scripts/golden-harness.mjs --lang ar --min-score 0.80
